title: AdjudicationCacheHit
description: Payload: an adjudication answered from the cache, so no call was made (S9) and nothing is spent. It names the earlier answer it was served from; the ledger checks that event has the same model, cropHash, candidateSetHash and choice. A cache hit is not new evidence (INV-6).

choice.description: A candidate workId, or null for none of them.

sourceEventSeq.description: Ledger position of the AdjudicationResult (or batch AdjudicationRecorded) the answer came from.
